description:
Ping remote services for availability

Heartbeat is a beat for testing service availability using PING based on ICMP, TCP or higher level protocols.
## Features and enhancements
- Build the input status report of Beat receivers in time linear in the number of inputs. #53723

## Fixes
- Fix quadratic cost of building the receiver config for units with many streams. #53726 #53731
- Update Brotli to 1.2.7 to fix a decoder panic on malformed input. #54234
- Reduce retries and repeated error logs from Beat receivers while the output is unreachable. #54271
- Fix "ApiVersionsRequest V3" errors on Kafka broker connections by updating the Sarama fork. #54546
- Stop leaking a thread per run when a browser monitor's synthetics command fails to start. #52405
